## Delivery Budget

- Estimate confidence: medium

| ID | Work item | Effort | Architecture delta | Debt claim | Addresses | Rationale |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| W1 | Terminal adapter and compatibility decision (phase 1) | 5 | 1 | - | - | New platform-facing lifecycle boundary, Bun/compiled validation, input and terminal restoration; adapter tests included. |
| W2 | Optional normalized metadata across bundled providers (phase 2) | 3 | 2 | - | - | Crosses public provider API, three mappers, invocation header producer, and compatibility fixtures; adds a maintained external contract without migration. |
| W3 | Replay-aware bounded tailing and decoding (phase 3) | 5 | 1 | - | - | Adds watermark/backpressure semantics to a filesystem boundary and a watch decoder; race, partial-record, polling, and legacy tests belong here. |
| W4 | Watch reducer, attribution, and retention (phase 4) | 5 | 2 | - | - | New bounded state machine for concurrent invocations, tools, prose, counters, and evictions; deterministic fixtures and stress tests included. |
| W5 | Responsive views and safe display formatting (phase 5) | 5 | 2 | - | - | New layout/formatting surface for compact/expanded views, Markdown, Unicode, path safety, inspectors, and activity clocks. |
| W6 | Keyboard controller and watch command wiring (phase 6) | 3 | 1 | - | - | Integrates CLI validation, async collection, viewport state, lifecycle adapter, and rendering while preserving stream modes. |
| W7 | Release failure handling, capability polish, and documentation (phase 7) | 2 | 0 | - | - | Finishes the existing watcher slice: failure/slow-terminal fixes, CLI help and docs, compiled/PTY validation, and manual acceptance; no new subsystem. |

### Surface Snapshot

- Subsystems: 4
- Production files: 18
- Persistent/external boundaries: 3

The four subsystems are provider normalization/log production; file tailing/decoding; watch state/presentation; CLI integration.

The 18 production files comprise 10 existing TypeScript files and 8 new `src/watch/` files listed below. A renderer dependency, if selected by W1, additionally changes package metadata/lockfile rather than adding an in-repo subsystem.

The three persistent/external boundaries are the normalized provider/plugin contract; NDJSON files on disk; interactive terminal input/output. No new database persistence.

findings.title: Workspace header is wrong for resumed OpenCode sessions
findings.failure: A resumed OpenCode session from a different workdir or worktree logs the wrong workspace, so all targets are shortened against the wrong root or mislabeled as outside the workspace.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Record the session-reported effective workspace (optional AgentSession.workingDirectory set by OpenCodeSession from session.directory and by the CLI providers from their cwd); use the requested workdir only for fresh sessions; omit workspace when unknown on resume; add an OpenCode resume fixture whose directory differs from the request.

findings.title: TUI signal handling ignores existing cli-lifecycle signal owner
findings.failure: A double SIGINT/SIGTERM, or cleanup stalled past the grace window, exits the process with the terminal left in raw mode on the alternate screen, violating the requirement that exceptional exits restore the terminal.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Merge getCliAbortSignal() into the controller abort, take the exit status from getCliAbortCause() (130/143), register a synchronous idempotent terminal restore on process exit while the UI is entered, and add PTY double-signal and grace-timeout cases.

findings.title: Bounded rotating drain reorders legacy raw/human replay across files
findings.failure: Replaying two invocation backlogs over 256 records in --human-readable mode interleaves them in 256-record chunks with repeated label headers, breaking the existing output contract that requirements section 7 says must be kept.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Drain historical (pre-watermark) data in sorted file order to completion across turns; apply rotation only to live data or only under the TUI option; add a multi-file backlog of more than 256 records per file as a regression test for raw and human modes.

findings.title: Paused viewport snapshot of rendered rows cannot survive resize
findings.failure: Resizing from 140x40 to 40x6 while paused either overflows or clips the snapshot, or discards it and loses operator focus, failing the resize-preserves-focus acceptance criterion.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Snapshot bounded width-independent row models (stable IDs, sanitized text, inspector detail) under the existing 256 KiB cap and render them at the current size; add a pause-resize-restore controller test.

findings.title: Phase 1 compiled/subprocess smoke has no entry point
findings.failure: The Phase 1 compatibility gate cannot be checked as written, so renderer selection could be accepted without compiled-binary evidence.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Name a test-only fixture entry (for example test/fixtures/watch-terminal-smoke.ts) and the exact bun build --compile command used to produce the recorded evidence.

baselineAssessment.reason: W1/W3/W4/W5/W7 scores are plausible; W2 (public contract, three mappers incl. new Claude stream message/block tracking, workspace producer with resume correction) and W6 (controller, key surface, viewport model, CLI preflight, cli-lifecycle integration) are each about 2 points light.

workItems.title: Terminal adapter and compatibility decision (phase 1)
workItems.rationale: New platform-facing lifecycle boundary, Bun/compiled validation, input and terminal restoration; adapter tests included. Scores unchanged: exit-time restore and a named test-only smoke entry clarify the existing lifecycle gate.

workItems.title: Optional normalized metadata across bundled providers (phase 2)
workItems.rationale: Crosses public provider API, three mappers, invocation header producer, and compatibility fixtures; adds a maintained external contract without migration. Scores unchanged: optional effective-cwd accessors correct the existing workspace deliverable, without a new subsystem.

workItems.title: Replay-aware bounded tailing and decoding (phase 3)
workItems.rationale: Adds watermark/backpressure semantics to a filesystem boundary and a watch decoder; race, partial-record, polling, and legacy tests belong here. Scores unchanged: mode-specific replay ordering and a larger regression fixture refine the existing compatibility work.

workItems.title: Watch reducer, attribution, and retention (phase 4)
workItems.rationale: New bounded state machine for concurrent invocations, tools, prose, counters, and evictions; deterministic fixtures and stress tests included. Scores unchanged: width-independent snapshot data replaces rendered rows within the existing cap.

workItems.title: Responsive views and safe display formatting (phase 5)
workItems.rationale: New layout/formatting surface for compact/expanded views, Markdown, Unicode, path safety, inspectors, and activity clocks. Scores unchanged: the same renderer reflows live or paused row models.

workItems.title: Keyboard controller and watch command wiring (phase 6)
workItems.rationale: Integrates CLI validation, async collection, viewport state, lifecycle adapter, and rendering while preserving stream modes. Scores unchanged: reuse existing signal ownership and re-layout the bounded snapshot rather than add parallel mechanisms.

workItems.title: Release failure handling, capability polish, and documentation (phase 7)
workItems.rationale: Finishes the existing watcher slice: failure/slow-terminal fixes, CLI help and docs, compiled/PTY validation, and manual acceptance; no new subsystem. Scores unchanged: double-signal/grace-timeout cases extend the planned lifecycle matrix.
